full_judgment: 9. Mr Fida M Kamal, the learned Counsel appearing on behalf of the defendant-petitioner, submits that judgment of the Court of appeal below is not a proper judgment of reversal. He further submits that the Court of appeal below misconstrued and misinterpreted the material evidences, particularly wasiatnama dated 19-34957, Exhibit H and thereby fallen into error of law in decreeing Partition Suit No. 63 of 1970. He further submits that the Court of Appeal below fails to consider that defendant No.1 acquired good title through wasiatnama dated 19-3-57. Learned Counsel further submits that the Court of Appeal below fails to read properly Exhibit-G, the patta and on misconstruction of Exhibits-G and H, that is patta and wasiatnama, wrongly held that defendant did not acquire any title over the suit land through these two deeds.
